raw_inputs.scene-S3.txt: Tamsin waited beside the archive desk with the ledger under her arm. Oren stood in the doorway behind the keeper. He held out his hand. She wanted an apology before she returned it. She was angry because no apology had come. The keeper stepped aside. Oren moved closer. Tamsin laid the ledger on the desk. She had decided to return it even though she was angry. Oren reached for it. She shifted it away from the puddle beneath his sleeve. The hook behind him was empty. The key had hung there yesterday. She wondered who had taken it and whether it had anything to do with her missing sister. 'Page nineteen is loose,' she said. He drew his wet sleeve back. She took her hand off the cover.
